nodes.name: SessionAction.java
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for session lifecycle actions that provides common logging and execution infrastructure.

nodes.name: SessionDestroyAction.java
nodes.summary: Session destroy action that performs cleanup: removing attributes, logging out users, deleting expired tickets, broadcasting to cluster, and releasing locks.

nodes.name: LogoutPostAction.java
nodes.summary: Post-logout action that records logout audit messages for authenticated users.

nodes.name: LogoutPreAction.java
nodes.summary: Pre-logout action stub providing extension point before user logout processing occurs.

nodes.name: ServicePreAction.java
nodes.summary: Core service pre-action that configures the full Liferay request context: theme display, layout, locale, user, group, portlet rendering state, and virtual host resolution.

nodes.name: SessionCreateAction.java
nodes.summary: Session create action that initializes session state, sets default locale, configures live users, and enforces concurrent session limits.

nodes.name: StartupHelper.java
nodes.summary: Marker interface for startup helper implementations used to trigger portal initialization and upgrade workflows.

nodes.name: StartupHelperUtil.java
nodes.summary: Utility that runs portal upgrade processes, initializes the main servlet context, upgrades Commerce, and checks for unregistered web contexts.
